verifiedFacts.fact: Tier-II results for Primary Teachers (PRTs) and Junior Secretariat Assistants declared on 14 September 2026.
verifiedFacts.source: CBSE Press Release dated 14 Sep 2026 (linked from kvsangathan.nic.in)

verifiedFacts.fact: For posts where an interview is part of the selection process, the Tier-II result indicates the candidate's status for shortlisting to the interview.
Interview/skill-test schedule and call letters will be made available in candidate logins after finalisation in consultation with KVS/NVS.
Marksheets for interview posts will be made available within 15 days from publication of the final result, after completion of the interview process.
Tier-II results for PGT (Hindi), TGT (Hindi) declared 05 Sep 2026; Principal on 03 Sep 2026; PGT (Chemistry), Assistant Commissioner, Junior Translator on 21 Aug 2026.
verifiedFacts.source: CBSE Press Releases dated 05 Sep 2026 and 21 Aug 2026

unverifiedButWidelyReported.claim: Final merit for teaching posts (incl. PRT) is prepared with 85% weightage to Tier-II and 15% to Interview/Demo lesson.
unverifiedButWidelyReported.note: Reported by coaching portals (testbook, adda247, careerpower). VERIFY against the official Recruitment Notification 01/2025 PDF in your candidate login before relying on it.

unverifiedButWidelyReported.claim: Older (2022-23) KVS pattern used Written 70% + Demo Teaching 15% + Interview 15% with a 180-question paper — this is NOT the current pattern.
unverifiedButWidelyReported.note: Do not prepare according to the old pattern.

kvsFacts.fact: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India; the Minister of Education is its Chairman.
KVS was started in 1963 (Central Schools scheme approved in 1962; Sangathan registered as a society in 1965).
kvsFacts.source: kvsangathan.nic.in (About KVS) — verify exact year wording on the official page.

kvsFacts.fact: KVS Headquarters: 18, Institutional Area, Shaheed Jeet Singh Marg, New Delhi – 110016.
KVS motto: 'तत्त्वं पूषन् अपावृणु' (Tattvam Pūṣan Apāvṛṇu) — from the Ishavasya Upanishad, meaning 'O Sun (nourisher), uncover the truth'.
KVs are affiliated to CBSE and follow NCERT curriculum; classes run in a common pattern across India so that children of transferable central government employees are not disadvantaged.
KVS is organised into Regional Offices and Zonal Institutes of Education and Training (ZIETs) for teacher training.
Number of KVs, regions and enrolment change every year — quote the latest figure from the official website's 'KVS at a glance' page on the day of the interview rather than a memorised number.

interviewPrepNote: Interview boards for PRT typically include KVS officials and subject/education experts. Expect questions on personal background, teaching philosophy, pedagogy, child psychology, classroom situations, NEP 2020 / NCF-FS 2022 / NCF-SE 2023, FLN (NIPUN Bharat), KVS itself, and current education topics. Demo-lesson expectations (if applicable) should be verified in the official call letter.
